description: The iPhone and iPad console for the coding agents on your own machines. Connects over SSH to Herdr TUI, the Herdr desktop app (herdr-core), or tmux, with native Chat, a real libghostty terminal, encrypted notifications and Live Activities, Usage limits, voice input, and built-in Tailscale, ZeroTier, and EasyTier
summary: Native iPhone and iPad console for herdr: watch and drive coding agents on your machines over SSH, in Herdr TUI or the Herdr desktop app (herdr-core), with a real libghostty terminal, native Chat, QR pairing, and push notifications when an agent needs you
